title: Permission sets: no way to grant "edit any record" without also granting delete (modifyAllRecords implies allowDelete)
body:
Ruled: 6377890121 · batch #9 item 1 (#25496, 6377842908) · letter A · 2026-10-24T00:43:45Z (keep Modify All semantics; REFUSE `modifyAllRecords: true` + `allowDelete: false` at publish time; "edit all, delete none" is expressed by RLS / sharing rules)

## Need

An app needs a role that can **edit records it does not own, but not delete them**. Today the only metadata that lets a non-owner edit on a `public_read` object is `modifyAllRecords: true`, and that bit also grants delete, even when the same entry says `allowDelete: false`.

Concrete case (hotsrm, objectstack-ai/hotsrm#14): `srm_material` is a read-only copy of ERP material master data, imported by an admin (so the admin owns every row). Buyers must maintain one field (`category`) on every row, with all other fields read-only via FLS, and must not create or delete materials.

```ts
// buyer permission set, object public_read
srm_material: { allowRead: true, allowCreate: false, allowEdit: true, allowDelete: false,
                viewAllRecords: true, modifyAllRecords: true },
```

Observed on 18.0.0 (in-process `@objectstack/verify` stack): the buyer's update of `category` succeeds, and **a delete by the same buyer also succeeds**. Without `modifyAllRecords` the update is refused by row-level security ("not permitted to update this 'srm_material' record").

In `plugin-security`, `MODIFY_ALL_WRITE_KEYS` contains both `allowEdit` and `allowDelete`, so `modifyAllRecords` widens both. That matches Salesforce "Modify All", but it leaves no declarative way to express "edit all, delete none".

## Workaround in use

We set the object's OWD to `public_read_write`, so `allowEdit` + FLS decide the edit and `allowDelete: false` still blocks delete. This widens the sharing model of the whole object, so every future permission set that grants `allowEdit` on it gets org-wide edit, which is not what the design wants (`public_read`).

## Possible shapes (any one would do)

1. ~~When an entry sets `modifyAllRecords: true` **and** `allowDelete: false` explicitly, honour `allowDelete: false` (bypass ownership for edit only).~~ (not chosen — changes the security semantics; ruling 6377890121)
2. ~~A separate bit, e.g. `editAllRecords` (ownership bypass for update only), alongside `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords`.~~ (not chosen; ruling 6377890121)
3. A sharing rule grant of edit access to a position without granting delete, if that is already intended to work, documented as the way to do this.

At minimum, a lint warning when an entry combines `modifyAllRecords: true` with `allowDelete: false`, since the `false` is silently ignored. (Ruled A goes further than a warning: the combination is **refused** at publish time.)
